question: What are visions opening, breaths throb, and being?
premises: The god-of-gods portion is visions opening.
Breaths throb is one-pointedness on that.
Being is the collection of its properties.
inference: Vision opens from the supreme portion, breath throbs one-pointed, being collects properties.
plain_english: For thus: the god-of-gods portion is the opening of vision; breath throb is one-pointedness on that; being is the collection of its properties.
